**Understanding dragByKey method**

I’m looking into the dragByKey method, which finds an element by key and calls _invokeDragInSubtree to initiate the drag callback. It prefers direct gesture callbacks for desktop to avoid issues with synthetic drags possibly missing recognizers. When picking a child widget inside a GestureDetector, the drag should still hit it and trigger onHorizontalDragStart as long as synthetic pointer events are within the GestureDetector. I think using start = ro.localToGlobal(ro.size.center(...)) is clever and ensures it all works well!

**Choosing keys for hero elements**

I need to select a key inside the hero that will always be present, like hero-song or hero-title, although these might vary per screen. The task specifies that evaluator-supplied media fixture files are mounted read-only at /opt/nothingness/media, consisting of 10 fixture files. I’m thinking tests might load these and display a hero featuring the song title. So, I should look for a stable key in the hero across all screens and search for ValueKey in the heroes.
